title: Reacting To The BEST MEMES After Raghav Chadha Joins BJP | END Of AAP?
description:
In this video, we discuss how seven AAP MPs, along with Raghav Chadha, are preparing to join BJP. It looks like things have become difficult for them inside AAP, and they now see BJP as a better option. We also talk about how this move could help BJP in Punjab, where leaders like Raghav Chadha and Harbhajan Singh still have strong influence. The video also covers the memes, reactions, and meltdowns coming after this political shift. We discuss Dhruv Rathee’s video targeting Raghav Chadha, what this means for AAP’s future, and how these MPs could give BJP a political advantage.
